subject.title: fix: CI checks fail after warm dependency restores

question: Does the CI owner accept disabling pnpm’s post-setup dependency-state repair for sticky-disk jobs after a refreshed current-main run confirms the restore-or-frozen-install invariant?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes CI dependency-repair policy; the supplied run is strong evidence, but the protected maintainer label requires an owner to accept the bounded automation tradeoff on the merge result.

options.title: Accept bounded sticky-disk override
options.body: Rebase or refresh the PR, confirm the two affected parallel boundary jobs retain the exact restore-or-install proof, and merge the current narrowly scoped override.

options.title: Retain pnpm verification
options.body: Keep pnpm’s pre-run verification and pursue a different serialization or dependency-layout solution if maintainers prefer repair-on-run over warm-snapshot performance.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded sticky-disk override
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the PR, confirm the two affected parallel boundary jobs retain the exact restore-or-install proof, and merge the current narrowly scoped override.
